QuestInfo.name: Something Foul
QuestInfo.0: Nella seems angry for some reason. Ask her what's up.
QuestInfo.1: Nella says JM is getting in the way of her work. For now, she wants you to deliver a letter to Matthias.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered Nella's Letter to Matthias. Something felt weird about the situation, though...

0.0: You sure JM asked you to do this, too? That's against the rules! Okay, I need you to do one more thing for me.

yes.0: Good. I want you to deliver this letter to Matthias. Make sure nobody sees you!

no.0: Hey, you don't wanna get on my bad side. I've got connections in Kerning City, you know.

1.0: Hm? A letter? From Nella, no less?

yes.0: Hmm... I see. Thank you. You may leave.

lost.0: If anyone finds the letter you lost, it'll be your head! Anyway, here. Take this to Matthias. And be more careful!
